description: This file defines the RevisionableInterface, an interface for entities supporting revisions in Drupal. It declares methods related to revision management such as creating new revisions, retrieving revision IDs, and checking revision status.

classes.name: RevisionableInterface
classes.description: An interface for entities that support revisions, providing methods to manage and query revision states.

methods.name: isNewRevision
methods.description: Determines whether a new revision should be created on save.

methods.name: setNewRevision
methods.description: Enforces an entity to be saved as a new revision.

methods.name: getRevisionId
methods.description: Gets the revision identifier of the entity.

methods.name: getLoadedRevisionId
methods.description: Gets the loaded Revision ID of the entity.

methods.name: updateLoadedRevisionId
methods.description: Updates the loaded Revision ID with the current revision ID.

methods.name: isDefaultRevision
methods.description: Checks if this entity is the default revision.

methods.name: wasDefaultRevision
methods.description: Checks whether the entity was a default revision when saved.

methods.name: isLatestRevision
methods.description: Checks if this entity is the latest revision.

methods.name: preSaveRevision
methods.description: Acts on a revision before it gets saved, with access to storage and revision record.
